why: `nros::MessageInfo`'s accessors. The type itself is `cpp:MessageInfo`/`rust:MessageInfo` (divergence: a flat struct of the fields the backends actually populate, not a wrapper over the DDS-shaped `rmw_message_info_t`). rclrs exposes the same information through its own `MessageInfo` but the members do not line up field for field, so each ours-only accessor is recorded rather than inherited.
